comment: Tile definition for the Taipei tile (issue #60): the tile is the UNION of the rectangles in `boxes`. Every pipeline stage reads this file — extract-from-pbf.py collects any OSM element touching a box (keyed by OSM id, so a way crossing a seam is collected once, whole), and the builders clip geometry against the union of the world-frame box rects. Adding a box is a config change here, not new code. `futureBoxes` are APPROVED shapes recorded for planning only: nothing reads them, and they must not be extracted until their own phase is approved.

futureBoxes.name: 3-corridor
futureBoxes.note: MRT red-line corridor (Yuanshan / Shilin / Shipai / Beitou stations) — future phase, do not extract.

futureBoxes.name: 4-beitou
futureBoxes.note: Beitou, where the red line turns west — future phase, do not extract. Height map / DEM terrain is deferred until these northern boxes.
